_comment: F33 surface-acceptance register (lane GATES-1, 2026-09-02, finish plan Wave 1). Every id here MUST match one of F33-surface-acceptance.mjs's hardcoded SPEC_SURFACES ids exactly (F33 checks both directions: a spec-named surface with no entry, and an entry naming a surface not in the hardcoded list, are both violations). Each entry carries EITHER {route, data_path, rendering_spec} (all three must exist on disk; data_path must be import-graph-reachable from route, not just name-matched) OR {exemption:{reason, ruled_by, date}}. Seeded honestly from the 2026-09-02 finish plan: built surfaces get real paths, the seven named-not-built items get exemptions citing the plan.
